top_signals.title: Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton warns Americans of 'bumps in the road' after tech outages
top_signals.summary: Clayton’s warning comes ahead of Thanksgiving travel, after separate outages disrupted air travel, Microsoft 365 and some bank transactions.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: By The Way: Headlines You May Have Missed
top_signals.summary: A gift of GTA VI coming with a contract, what that SNL ‘Sister’ sketch says about American healthcare, Robert Pattinson as Bond, and the F1 aspirations of children: Join Lisa Mateo, David Gura and Christina Ruffini for a roundup of headlines you may have missed, but gotta see. (Source: Bloomberg)
